Select canonical_smiles, molecule chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL1217643. Join activities to assays on assay_id filtering assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to exact measurements only: standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL and standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
